latest.title: LifeOS 2.8.0
latest.summary: Adaptive check-ins: 100 questions LifeOS can ask — only one at a time, only when useful, often none.

notes.title: Check-ins that know when to stay quiet
notes.text: 100 check-ins across sleep, food, movement, work, plans, mood and money — but LifeOS asks at most one at a time, only when the answer could change something, never what you just told it, and often chooses silence. Your answers are saved as facts you can edit or delete; empty means “unknown”, never a guess.

notes.title: Facts, calculations and possible patterns — kept apart
notes.text: Reports now separate what you logged, what LifeOS calculated (with how), and what may be happening. Patterns need at least 5 observations, show the counts, and are always associations — never causes or diagnoses.

notes.title: Your limits, your targets
notes.text: Quiet, Balanced and Active modes cap check-ins at 2, 4 or 6 a day. Skip a question three times and it stops. Sleep and water comparisons use only targets you set. Health topics like body, digestion, caffeine and medication are off until you turn them on.

notes.title: AI that recovers from format errors
notes.text: When the AI answers in a format the app can’t read, LifeOS now salvages the reply, retries in a simpler mode, and falls back to a more dependable model — instead of showing an error. Fixes failures while designing trackers and planning your day.

notes.title: Clearer when AI is off
notes.text: Smart features now tell you when they’re running in basic mode, and “Turn on AI” takes one step. The day planner also leaves out “tasks” that are really your schedule (like office hours) and shows which tasks it used.

notes.title: LifeOS pays attention
notes.text: A “Right now” card on Today asks the one question that fits the moment — before a meeting, after it ends, your morning check-in, an evening review, a quick energy pulse, a goal you haven’t logged. Tap an answer and it does something: logs, adds a task, starts focus.

notes.title: Plan my day
notes.text: LifeOS finds the free time between your events and lays your tasks into it as focus blocks with breaks, based on your energy. Review, untick, and add it to your calendar.

notes.title: Check-in notifications
notes.text: A gentle morning and evening nudge — at times you choose — that mentions what’s on your day. They respect quiet hours and your coaching tone.

notes.title: Your Google Calendar, in LifeOS
notes.text: Connect Google Calendar (read-only) and its events — including repeating ones — appear on Today, Plan and the month calendar next to your tasks, routines and focus sessions. Tap any event to turn it into a task, tracker, reminder or focus session.

notes.title: Daily tips and general reminders
notes.text: A simple wellbeing tip every day, plus gentle reminders — water, stretch, rest your eyes, wind down — that you can switch on, retime or add to. Includes tips tailored to what you track. General information, not medical advice.

notes.title: Ask me questions
notes.text: Add a thought in plain words and LifeOS asks a few focused follow-up questions — what to measure, how often, a target, a date — then builds a better tracker, goal, note, task, event or routine. Tap an answer or type your own, or skip any of it.

notes.title: Focus timer
notes.text: Turn focus on when you need to concentrate. Pick a length (or open-ended), keep reminders quiet, and get a notification when time is up. Sessions are saved and can feed a “Focus time” tracker.

notes.title: Month calendar with everything
notes.text: Plan → Month shows events, tasks, routines, tracker reminders, focus sessions and goal dates in one place. Tap anything to turn it into a task, a tracker, a reminder, a focus session or an event.

notes.title: Background reminders, made visible
notes.text: You → Background reminders now shows whether the reminder clock is running, and a reminder that already reached you in the background no longer pops up a second time when you open the app.

notes.title: Make Today yours
notes.text: Choose which cards show on Today and put them in your order — routines, trackers, advisor, glance and more. Find it under Customize Today.

notes.title: Describe your routines in words
notes.text: “Gym Mon, Wed, Fri 7–8am, wind-down weekdays 10pm with a reminder to put the phone away.” LifeOS builds the routines and reminders and you review them before saving.

notes.title: Your coaching tone
notes.text: Pick Gentle, Direct or Minimal. Reminders, nudges and the AI’s wording follow your style — the facts and numbers never change.

notes.title: Clearer notification test
notes.text: In You → Background reminders, “Send a test” now tells you how many of your devices it was sent to.

notes.title: Goals you can reach
notes.text: Say “reduce my weight to 80 kg in 8 weeks” and LifeOS tracks progress from where you start, estimates your pace and finish date, and suggests next steps — from your own numbers, plus optional AI coaching.

notes.title: Reminders even when LifeOS is closed
notes.text: Turn on background reminders in You and your water, break and lunch nudges and tracker reminders arrive as notifications while the app is closed. Quiet hours are respected; only reminder text is sent.

notes.title: Describe it, and it builds itself
notes.text: Tell LifeOS what you want to track in your own words. It designs the tracker — fields, targets, reminders — and you review it before anything is saved.

notes.title: Track anything
notes.text: Numbers, scales, yes/no, choices, durations and notes, with daily totals, targets, streaks and charts that fit what you defined.

notes.title: Type anything, it goes to the right place
notes.text: “Ran 8k, left knee sore” is sorted into the right trackers automatically, with a quick check when unsure.

notes.title: Your own rules
notes.text: Write a rule in a sentence — “if I sleep under 6 hours twice this week, tell me to keep the evening free” — and LifeOS watches for it.

notes.title: Ask your own questions
notes.text: Pick any two things you track and see how they relate, with honest confidence — never a made-up cause.

notes.title: A Today that’s yours
notes.text: Pin the trackers you care about to Today, or switch to a blank canvas with none of the built-in sleep, mood and routine suggestions.

notes.title: Templates and CSV
notes.text: Start from a template, share your setup with a friend (no data included), and import your history from a spreadsheet.

notes.title: AI included
notes.text: Sign in and the advisor works without pasting a key (daily limit). Your own key still works and takes priority.

notes.title: Safer updates
notes.text: Updates now ask first, show what changed, save your data, and never touch your original LifeOS data.
